Tanuki Sake is an independent craft brewery rooted in Japanese folklore and a deep love for bold, experimental brew. The brief was to build a brand that felt handcrafted and irreverent, something that stood apart on a crowded tap wall and made people reach for it before they even read the label.

The logo is based off the mischievous tanuki spirit: hand-rendered illustrations, playful trickster mythology, and bold typography that carries the story into every bottle. A brand that's as fun as it looks.

My Role

Ferrari approached us to design a brand-compliant web page that functions as a direct extension of their Tier 1 digital ecosystem. Every decision (type, spacing, colour, interaction) was validated against Ferrari's official brand standards before a single element was placed.

The result is a seamless handoff from the global Ferrari site: a page that feels native to the Ferrari world, built to compliance specification without sacrificing creative precision. A study in restraint, speed, and strict adherence to Ferrari's brand standards.

My Role

The brief was to make gut health feel like a party. The brand leans all the way into fun: a bouncy, oversized wordmark, saturated color pops, and real fruit photography that makes every can look as good as it tastes.

The logo is a bouncy, gut-friendly wordmark paired with hyper-realistic fruit photography across all four flavors, art directed to feel glossy, oversized, and fresh. A flavor system built to scale without losing its bounce.
